2. For each character in the plaintext:

   b. If it is an uppercase letter, convert to lowercase, find its index, add 5, take modulo 36, convert the resulting character to uppercase (if it is a letter), and replace.
   c. If it is any other character (space, punctuation, etc.), leave it unchanged.

The economic devastation of the Great Depression had left millions of Germans unemployed and disillusioned with the Weimar Democracy.
